notes.title: Pirate MMORPG sets sail for the afterlife in spooky new update
notes.content:
Pirates are cool and remain cool, no matter how much various overstayed-their-welcome movie franchises try to make pirates uncool. There's something about the jolly roger, the yo-ho-ho-ing, and leaping aboard enemy ships that just sings to our hearts. They're cool and so it's always a wonder that we don't have more pirate games. Thankfully games like Pirate101 continue to fly the black flag and with its next major update, that flag is about to get a little bit darker.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Sinbad Chapter 2 Teaser!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049597/b6c183e23316ee1f3ece28eab28beac37fe5144a.png[/img]
The game's launch on Steam isn't the only thing to get excited about in the near future! A new game update is sailing your way soon - gear up with Sinbad Chapter 2: The Iron Lotus! This year will bring new challenges... and rewards!

In our excitement to show you the next update, we hid a tease within a tease! 😮

While the weapons shown in this piece of concept art will be available in the upcoming Sinbad Chapter 2 update, the outfit will arrive in a later update.
